payload.description: Compare open-source task-retrieval and relationship models against the preserved Laya pilot. Expanded at user's request: train/distill a specialized non-generative dense or static relation encoder with target budgets near 10M and 100M total parameters, and tokenizer-vocabulary ablations including 100k/200k tokens where feasible. Use user request Q and assistant response/plan A as separate evidence channels: test Q only, A only, Q+A concatenation and a predeclared fusion. Benchmark retrieval across large Markdown and structured DIP stores, not only classification of one supplied pair. Research shortlist includes Model2Vec/Potion (7.6M/32.3M English and128.1M multilingual), multilingual E5-small and MiniLM-L12 (~117.7M, Hebrew listed), small English BGE/MiniLM controls, and larger GTE/Qwen/BGE reranker references. The bounded pretrained stage task_358d32ed-9c7b-453e-a23f-244f00ef174c evaluated seven pinned alternatives plus BM25 on new family-separated synthetic retrieval/pair cases. Multilingual MiniLM raw top10 44/48, E5 43/48, Potion multilingual37/48 versus BM25 24/48 at10k; this is not autonomous identity or real-agent quality. Custom training, larger references, independent labels and downstream evaluation remain unperformed. Licensed source/weight review and independent held-out evaluation required.
